---
title: "Parental Assignment of Individual Contigs"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
# create output directories
outdir_assignment                 <- file.path(currentdir, "04_assignment")
outdir_assignment_anchors         <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "00_anchors")
outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup  <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "01_intrahap_dedup")
outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup  <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "02_crosshap_dedup")
outdir_assignment_rrna            <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "03_rrna")
outdir_assignment_assignment      <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "04_assignment")
outdir_assignment_dvscoring       <- file.path(outdir_assignment_assignment, "01_dvscoring")
outdir_assignment_paircov         <- file.path(outdir_assignment_assignment, "02_pair_cov")
outdir_assignment_dvkmers         <- file.path(outdir_assignment_assignment, "03_dvkmers")
outdir_assignment_final           <- file.path(outdir_assignment, "05_final")

sapply(c(outdir_assignment_anchors, outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, outdir_assignment_rrna, outdir_assignment_dvscoring, outdir_assignment_paircov, outdir_assignment_dvkmers, outdir_assignment_final), function(x) {
  if (!dir.exists(x)) { dir.create(x, recursive=T) }})

# check if both parental reference genomes exist
if (!all(file.exists(params$fn_ref_decipiens, params$fn_ref_virginea))) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "One or both reference genomes is not found. Exited.")
    knitr::knit_exit()
}

# update the headers of reference genomes
fn_ref_dec <- file.path(outdir_assignment_anchors, "ref_dec.fna")
fn_ref_vir <- file.path(outdir_assignment_anchors, "ref_vir.fna")

if (!all(file.exists(fn_ref_dec, fn_ref_vir)) || params$redo) {
    f_update_headers(ref_dec     = params$fn_ref_decipiens,
                     ref_vir     = params$fn_ref_virginea,
                     ref_dec_out = fn_ref_dec,
                     ref_vir_out = fn_ref_vir)
}
```

```{r anchors}
# output files
fn_hap1_dec_paf  <- file.path(outdir_assignment_dvscoring, "hap1_dec.paf")
fn_hap1_vir_paf  <- file.path(outdir_assignment_dvscoring, "hap1_vir.paf")
fn_hap2_dec_paf  <- file.path(outdir_assignment_dvscoring, "hap2_dec.paf")
fn_hap2_vir_paf  <- file.path(outdir_assignment_dvscoring, "hap2_vir.paf")


# output variable
ls_anchors <- c()

# iterate over haplotypes
for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
    # input and output files
    fn_hap     <- if (hap == "hap1") fn_hap1         else fn_hap2
    fn_dec_paf <- if (hap == "hap1") fn_hap1_dec_paf else fn_hap2_dec_paf
    fn_vir_paf <- if (hap == "hap1") fn_hap1_vir_paf else fn_hap2_vir_paf

    # align the haplotype to both parental references
    for (ref in c("dec", "vir")) {
        # output file
        fn_paf <- if (ref == "dec") fn_dec_paf else fn_vir_paf

        # run minimap2
        if (!file.exists(fn_paf) || params$redo) {
            f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = if (ref == "dec") fn_ref_dec else fn_ref_vir,
                           minimap_params = "-cx asm20 -N 1000 --secondary=no",
                           fn_query       = fn_hap,
                           fn_out         = fn_paf,
                           thread         = params$thread,
                           exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)
        }
    }

    # open the output files
    df_fai        <- data.table::fread(paste0(fn_hap, ".fai"), header=F, select=1:2, col.names=c("contig", "length"), colClasses=list(character=1))
    ls_df_paf_ref <- lapply(c(dec=fn_dec_paf, vir=fn_vir_paf), function(fn) {
                         f_read_paf(fn) %>% mutate(identity = if_else(is.na(de), nmatch / alen, 1 - de))
                     })
    
    # extract the anchor contigs
    df_anchors    <- f_find_anchors(df_fai        = df_fai,
                                    ls_df_paf_ref = ls_df_paf_ref,
                                    min_ref_cov   = 0.2)
    data.table::fwrite(df_anchors, file.path(outdir_assignment_anchors, paste0(hap, "_anchors.tsv")), sep="\t", quote=F)

    # sanity check: every reference chromosome should be covered by the anchors of each haplotype
    df_chr_cov <- df_anchors %>%
                    filter(anchor) %>%
                    group_by(ref_chrom) %>%
                    summarise(cov = sum(ref_cov))
    log4r::info(fn_logger, paste0(hap, ": ", sum(df_anchors$anchor), " chromosome-scale contigs on ",
                                  nrow(df_chr_cov), " reference chromosomes (",
                                  paste(df_chr_cov$ref_chrom[df_chr_cov$cov < 0.5], collapse=", "), " below 50%)"))

    # update the list
    ls_anchors <- c(ls_anchors, df_anchors$contig[df_anchors$anchor])
}

writeLines(ls_anchors, con=file.path(outdir_assignment_anchors, "chromosome_scale_contigs.txt"))
```


```{r intrahap}
# check if output files exist
fn_hap1_self <- file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, "hap1_hap1.paf")
fn_hap2_self <- file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, "hap2_hap2.paf")

if (!all(file.exists(fn_hap1_self, fn_hap2_self)) || params$redo) {
    # map hap1 to itself
    f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_hap1,
                   minimap_params = "-cx asm20 -DP -m200",
                   fn_query       = fn_hap1,
                   fn_out         = fn_hap1_self,
                   thread         = params$thread,
                   exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)

    # map hap2 to itself
    f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_hap2,
                   minimap_params = "-cx asm20 -DP -m200",
                   fn_query       = fn_hap2,
                   fn_out         = fn_hap2_self,
                   thread         = params$thread,
                   exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)
}

# iterate over haplotypes
for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
    # read the PAF file
    df_paf <- f_read_paf(file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_", hap, ".paf")))

    # filter contig pairs
    df_paf <- df_paf %>%
                filter(qname != tname & alen >= 10000) %>%                      # exclude self-hits and short alignments
                filter(tlen > qlen | (tlen == qlen & tname > qname)) %>%        # exclude queries longer than targets and duplicates
                mutate(identity = ifelse(is.na(de), nmatch/alen, 1-de)) %>%     # calculate pairwise identity
                filter(identity >= 0.9)                                         # exclude low-identity alignments
    
    # calculate statistics per contig
    df_contig <- df_paf %>%
                    group_by(contig = qname) %>%
                    summarise(
                        length       = first(qlen),
                        frac_covered = round(f_calculate_merged_len(qstart, qend) / first(qlen), 3),
                        max_identity = round(max(identity), 3),
                        contained_in = f_extract_top_targets(qstart, qend, identity, tname),
                        depth_cutoff = 55 - (27.5 / 2) * frac_covered
                    )
    
    # save the list of putative duplicated contigs
    ls_length <- setNames(df_contig$length, df_contig$contig)
    ls_dups   <- df_contig$contig[df_contig$frac_covered >= 0.8]

    # save the contigs as BED file
    fn_bed <- file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups.bed"))
    df_bed <- data.table::data.table(chrom=ls_dups, start=0, end=ls_length[ls_dups])
    data.table::fwrite(df_bed, file=fn_bed, sep="\t", col.names=FALSE)
    
    # calculate the mean read depth of each contig
    fn_regions_bed <- file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups.regions.bed.gz"))

    f_mosdepth(fn_bam       = file.path(outdir_blobtools_minimap, paste0(hap, ".bam")),
               fn_bed       = fn_bed,
               prefix       = file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups")),
               thread       = params$thread,
               exe_mosdepth = params$exe_mosdepth)
    
    # open the BED file
    ls_lines <- readLines(gzfile(fn_regions_bed))
    df_depth <- data.table::fread(text=c("contig\tstart\tend\tdepth", ls_lines), sep="\t", header=TRUE)
    ls_depth <- setNames(df_depth$depth, df_depth$contig)

    # add the depth column to df_contig
    df_contig$depth  <- unname(ls_depth[df_contig$contig])

    # output variable
    ls_decision <- character(0)

    # iterate over contigs from shortest to longest
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_contig))) {
        ctg        <- df_contig$contig[i]
        ctg_depth  <- df_contig$depth[i]
        cutoff     <- df_contig$depth_cutoff[i]
        identity   <- df_contig$max_identity[i]

        # make a decision on each contig
        if (is.na(ctg_depth)) {
            ls_decision[ctg] <- "keep (not candidate)"
        } else if (ctg_depth <= cutoff) {
            ls_decision[ctg] <- "drop (low depth)"
        } else {
            ls_decision[ctg] <- "keep (high coverage)"
        }
    }

    # add the decision column to df_frag
    df_contig$decision <- unname(ls_decision[df_contig$contig])

    # save data.frame
    fn_output <- file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_summary.tsv"))
    data.table::fwrite(df_contig, file=fn_output, sep="\t", quote=FALSE)

    # save the list of kept and dropped contigs
    ls_keep <- df_contig %>% filter(startsWith(decision, "keep")) %>% pull(contig)
    writeLines(ls_keep, con=file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_keep.txt")))

    ls_drop <- df_contig %>% filter(startsWith(decision, "drop")) %>% pull(contig)
    writeLines(ls_drop, con=file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_drop.txt")))
}
```

```{r crosshap}
# open the union index file
df_fai    <- data.table::fread(paste0(fn_hap_union, ".fai"), header=FALSE, select=1:2, col.names=c("contig", "length"))
ls_length <- setNames(df_fai$length, df_fai$contig)
ls_pool   <- df_fai$contig

# exclude chromosome-scale contigs
ls_excluded <- ls_anchors
ls_pool     <- ls_pool[!ls_pool %in% ls_excluded]

# write the list of contigs to a file
fn_pool_txt <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "pool.txt")
writeLines(ls_pool, con=fn_pool_txt)

# extract the pooled contigs and map the pooled contigs to the union
fn_pool_fa   <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "pool.fa")
fn_union_paf <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "union.paf")

if (!all(file.exists(fn_pool_fa, fn_union_paf)) || params$redo) {
    system(paste(params$exe_seqkit, "grep -f", fn_pool_txt, fn_hap_union, ">", fn_pool_fa))

    f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_hap_union,
                   minimap_params = "-cx asm20",
                   fn_query       = fn_pool_fa,
                   fn_out         = fn_union_paf,
                   thread         = params$thread,
                   exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)
}

# read the PAF file
df_paf <- f_read_paf(fn_union_paf)

# filter contig pairs
df_paf <- df_paf %>%
            filter(qname != tname & alen >= 10000) %>%               # exclude self-hits and short alignments
            mutate(identity = ifelse(is.na(de), nmatch/alen, 1-de))  # calculate pairwise identity

# extract the best hit for each contig
df_best_aln <- df_paf %>%
                group_by(contig = qname) %>%
                mutate(best_hit = tname[which.max(identity)]) %>%
                filter(tname == best_hit) %>%  
                summarise(best_hit     = first(best_hit),
                          identity     = max(identity),
                          frac_covered = round(f_calculate_merged_len(qstart, qend) / first(qlen), 3))

# classify each contig (including those with no hit)
df_frag <- tibble(fragment = ls_pool, length = unname(ls_length[ls_pool])) %>%
              left_join(df_best_aln, by = join_by(fragment == contig)) %>%
              mutate(best_hit     = coalesce(best_hit, "-"),
                     identity     = coalesce(identity, 0),
                     frac_covered = coalesce(frac_covered, 0),
                     class        = case_when(best_hit == "-" ~ "no-hit",
                                              identity >= 0.995 & frac_covered >= 0.5 ~ "duplicate",
                                              .default = "own-sequence"))

# check duplicated contigs' depth
for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
    # output file
    fn_bed <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups.bed"))

    # extract haplotype-specific contigs
    hap_prefix <- ifelse(hap=="hap1", "h1", "h2")
    ls_dups <- df_frag %>% filter(class == "duplicate" & startsWith(fragment, hap_prefix)) %>% pull(fragment)   
    if (length(ls_dups) == 0) {
        unlink(fn_bed)
        next
    }

    # save the contigs as BED file
    df_bed <- data.table::data.table(chrom=ls_dups, start=0, end=ls_length[ls_dups])
    data.table::fwrite(df_bed, file=fn_bed, sep="\t", col.names=FALSE)
    
    # calculate the mean read depth of each contig
    f_mosdepth(fn_bam       = file.path(outdir_blobtools_minimap, paste0(hap, ".bam")),
               fn_bed       = fn_bed,
               prefix       = file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dups")),
               thread       = params$thread,
               exe_mosdepth = params$exe_mosdepth)
}

# combine the two files
fn_all_regions <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "all.dups.regions.bed.gz")
system(paste("zcat",
             file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "hap1.dups.regions.bed.gz"),
             file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "hap2.dups.regions.bed.gz"),
             "2>/dev/null | gzip >", fn_all_regions))

# open the BED file
ls_lines <- readLines(gzfile(fn_all_regions))
df_depth <- data.table::fread(text=c("contig\tstart\tend\tdepth", ls_lines), sep="\t", header=TRUE)
ls_depth <- setNames(df_depth$depth, df_depth$contig)

# add the depth column to df_frag
df_frag$depth <- unname(ls_depth[df_frag$fragment])

# output variable
ls_decision <- character(0)

# iterate over contigs from shortest to longest
for (i in order(df_frag$length)) {
    frag         <- df_frag$fragment[i]
    hit          <- df_frag$best_hit[i]
    frag_depth   <- df_frag$depth[i]

    # keep undocumented hit as it has to be longer than frag
    hit_decision <- ifelse (hit %in% names(ls_decision), ls_decision[[hit]], "keep") 

    # make a decision on each contig
    if (df_frag$class[i] != "duplicate") {
        ls_decision[frag] <- "keep"
    } else if (is.na(frag_depth) || frag_depth > 41.25) {
        ls_decision[frag] <- "keep (shared sequence)"
    } else if (hit %in% ls_excluded || startsWith(hit_decision, "keep")) {
        ls_decision[frag] <- "drop (single-parent copy)"
    } else {
        ls_decision[frag] <- "keep (only remaining copy)"
    }
}

# add the decision column to df_frag
df_frag$decision <- unname(ls_decision[df_frag$fragment])

# store all information in one data.frame
df_out <- df_frag %>%
            arrange(desc(length)) %>%
            transmute(fragment,
                      length,
                      best_hit,
                      identity     = sprintf("%.3f", identity),
                      frac_covered = round(frac_covered, 3),
                      depth        = if_else(is.na(depth), "-", sprintf("%.1f", depth)),
                      class,
                      decision)
data.table::fwrite(df_out, file=file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "summary.txt"), sep="\t", quote=F)

# save the list of dropped contigs
ls_drop <- df_out %>% filter(startsWith(decision, "drop")) %>% pull(fragment)
writeLines(ls_drop, con=file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "drop.txt"))
```

```{r rrna}
# list of rRNA genes
ls_genes   <- c("18S_rRNA", "5_8S_rRNA", "28S_rRNA", "5S_rRNA")

# run nhmmer
if (!is.null(params$fn_rrna_db) && file.exists(params$fn_rrna_db)) {
    for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
        # input files
        fn_hap     <- file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, paste0("hifiasm_asm.bp.", hap, ".p_ctg.fa"))
        fn_wrapped <- file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, ".wrapped.fa"))
        fn_tblout  <- file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, "_rrna.tbl"))
        fn_out     <- file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, "_rrna_counts.tsv"))
    
        # line-wrapped copy of the assembly for nhmmer
        if (!file.exists(fn_wrapped) || params$redo) {
            system(paste(params$exe_seqkit, "seq -w 60", fn_hap, ">", fn_wrapped))
        }

        # search for rRNA genes
        if (!file.exists(fn_tblout) || params$redo) {
            f_nhmmer(fn_hmm     = params$fn_rrna_db,
                     fn_fasta   = fn_wrapped,
                     fn_tblout  = fn_tblout,
                     thread     = params$thread,
                     exe_nhmmer = params$exe_nhmmer) 
        }

        # read the rRNA table
        df_rrna <- f_read_nhmmer_tblout(fn_tblout) %>%
                        count(contig = target, gene = query) %>%
                        complete(contig, gene = ls_genes, fill = list(n = 0)) %>% 
                        pivot_wider(names_from = gene, values_from = n) %>%
                        select(contig, all_of(ls_genes)) %>%
                        mutate(total = rowSums(across(all_of(ls_genes)))) %>%
                        arrange(desc(total)) %>%
                        filter(total >= 5)

        data.table::fwrite(df_rrna, file=fn_out, sep="\t", quote=F)

        # open the list of contigs with high coverage
        ls_keep <- readLines(file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_keep.txt")))

        # drop duplicate rRNA genes
        ls_drop <- df_rrna$contig[df_rrna$contig %in% ls_keep & !df_rrna$contig %in% ls_anchors]
        writeLines(ls_drop, con=file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, "_drop.txt")))
    }
}
```

```{r deduplication}
# output files
fn_hap1_dedup <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "hap1.dedup.fa")
fn_hap2_dedup <- file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "hap2.dedup.fa")

# iterate over haplotypes
if (!all(file.exists(fn_hap1_dedup, fn_hap2_dedup)) || params$redo) {
    for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
        # open all contigs to remove
        ls_organelle <- readLines(file.path(outdir_organelle_assembly, paste0(hap, "_organelle.txt")))
        ls_intradups <- readLines(file.path(outdir_assignment_intrahap_dedup, paste0(hap, "_drop.txt")))
        ls_crossdups <- readLines(file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, "drop.txt"))
        ls_to_remove <- unique(c(ls_organelle, ls_intradups, ls_crossdups))

        # open rRNA genes
        fn_rrna_drop <- file.path(outdir_assignment_rrna, paste0(hap, "_drop.txt"))
        if (file.exists(fn_rrna_drop)) {
            ls_rrna      <- readLines(fn_rrna_drop)
            ls_to_remove <- unique(c(ls_to_remove, ls_rrna))
        }

        # open the FASTA sequence
        seq <- Biostrings::readBStringSet(file.path(outdir_hifiasm_assembly, paste0("hifiasm_asm.bp.", hap, ".p_ctg.fa")))
        seq <- seq[!names(seq) %in% ls_to_remove]
        Biostrings::writeXStringSet(seq, filepath=file.path(outdir_assignment_crosshap_dedup, paste0(hap, ".dedup.fa")))
    }
}

# index the FASTA file
system(paste(params$exe_samtools, "faidx", fn_hap1_dedup))
system(paste(params$exe_samtools, "faidx", fn_hap2_dedup))
```

```{r dv-scoring}
# output file
fn_hap1_hap2_paf <- file.path(outdir_assignment_dvscoring, "hap1_hap2.paf")

# run minimap2
if (!file.exists(fn_hap1_hap2_paf) || params$redo) {
    f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_hap2_dedup,
                   minimap_params = "-cx asm20 -N 1000 --secondary=no",
                   fn_query       = fn_hap1_dedup,
                   fn_out         = fn_hap1_hap2_paf,
                   thread         = params$thread,
                   exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)
}

# score each pair
df_hap1_dec  <- f_score_paf(fn_paf = fn_hap1_dec_paf, min_aln = 1000, min_id = 0.8)
df_hap1_vir  <- f_score_paf(fn_paf = fn_hap1_vir_paf, min_aln = 1000, min_id = 0.8)
df_hap2_dec  <- f_score_paf(fn_paf = fn_hap2_dec_paf, min_aln = 1000, min_id = 0.8)
df_hap2_vir  <- f_score_paf(fn_paf = fn_hap2_vir_paf, min_aln = 1000, min_id = 0.8)

# extract best pairs of individual contigs
ls_partners <- f_partners(fn_hap1_hap2_paf)

# extract the stats from Blobtools
df_blob1    <- f_read_blob(file.path(outdir_hifiasm_blobtools, "hap1_btk.tsv"))
df_blob2    <- f_read_blob(file.path(outdir_hifiasm_blobtools, "hap2_btk.tsv"))

# set output variable
df_rows <- data.table::data.table()

# store all output in a list
ls_haps <- list(hap1=list(dec=df_hap1_dec, vir=df_hap1_vir, partner=ls_partners$best_h1, len=ls_partners$len_h1, blob=df_blob1),
                hap2=list(dec=df_hap2_dec, vir=df_hap2_vir, partner=ls_partners$best_h2, len=ls_partners$len_h2, blob=df_blob2))

# iterate over haplotypes
for (hap in names(ls_haps)) {
    # input variables
    df_dec     <- ls_haps[[hap]]$dec
    df_vir     <- ls_haps[[hap]]$vir
    df_partner <- ls_haps[[hap]]$partner
    df_len     <- ls_haps[[hap]]$len
    df_blob    <- ls_haps[[hap]]$blob

    # extract all contigs that are found across output
    ls_contigs       <- sort(unique(c(df_dec$contig, df_vir$contig, df_len$contig)))
    ls_dedup_contigs <- unlist(lapply(c(fn_hap1_dedup, fn_hap2_dedup), function(fn) {
        data.table::fread(paste0(fn, ".fai"), header=F, select=1, colClasses="character")[[1]]
    }))
    ls_contigs       <- ls_contigs[ls_contigs %in% ls_dedup_contigs]

    # index contigs across output
    idx_dec  <- match(ls_contigs, df_dec$contig)
    idx_vir  <- match(ls_contigs, df_vir$contig)
    idx_len  <- match(ls_contigs, df_len$contig)
    idx_part <- match(ls_contigs, df_partner$contig)
    idx_blob <- match(ls_contigs, df_blob$contig)

    # contig length: from the decipiens scores, else virginea, else the hap1-vs-hap2 PAF, else 0
    length <- coalesce(df_dec$len[idx_dec], df_vir$len[idx_vir], df_len$len[idx_len], 0)

    # store all information in a data.frame
    df_hap <- data.table::data.table(contig      = ls_contigs,
                                     hap         = hap,
                                     length      = length,
                                     gc          = df_blob$gc[idx_blob],
                                     cov         = df_blob$cov[idx_blob],
                                     phylum      = ifelse(is.na(idx_blob), "NA", df_blob$phylum[idx_blob]),
                                     dec_chrom   = ifelse(is.na(idx_dec),  "-",  df_dec$chrom[idx_dec]),
                                     vir_chrom   = ifelse(is.na(idx_vir),  "-",  df_vir$chrom[idx_vir]),
                                     dec_aligned = ifelse(is.na(idx_dec),  0,    100 * df_dec$aligned[idx_dec]),
                                     vir_aligned = ifelse(is.na(idx_vir),  0,    100 * df_vir$aligned[idx_vir]),
                                     dec_id      = df_dec$identity[idx_dec],
                                     vir_id      = df_vir$identity[idx_vir],
                                     partner     = ifelse(is.na(idx_part), "-",  df_partner$partner[idx_part]))

    # add the comparison between dec and vir
    df_hap$delta <- df_hap$dec_id - df_hap$vir_id
    df_hap$ratio <- ifelse(!is.na(idx_dec) & !is.na(idx_vir) & df_hap$vir_aligned > 0,
                           df_hap$dec_aligned / df_hap$vir_aligned, NA)

    # call the parent of every contig
    df_hap$call <- sapply(seq_along(ls_contigs), function(i) {
        f_call(dec_aligned = df_dec$aligned[idx_dec[i]],
               vir_aligned = df_vir$aligned[idx_vir[i]],
               dec_id      = df_hap$dec_id[i],
               vir_id      = df_hap$vir_id[i],
               min_aligned = 0.2,
               margin      = 0.5)
    })

    # update the output data.frame
    df_rows <- rbind(df_rows, df_hap)
}

# save the data.frame
data.table::fwrite(df_rows, file=file.path(outdir_assignment_dvscoring, "dv_scoring.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

# extract the partner of each contig
for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
    data.table::fwrite(f_interleave_partners(df_rows, hap),
                       file=file.path(outdir_assignment_dvscoring, paste0("dv_scoring_", hap, ".tsv")), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
}
```

```{r pair-cov}
# output files
fn_hap2_hap1_paf <- file.path(outdir_assignment_paircov, "hap1_hap2.paf")
fn_union_paf     <- file.path(outdir_assignment_paircov, "union.paf")
fn_pairs         <- file.path(outdir_assignment_paircov, "summary.tsv")

# run minimap2
if (!file.exists(fn_hap2_hap1_paf) || params$redo) {
    f_minimap2_paf(fn_ref         = fn_hap1_dedup,
                   minimap_params = "-cx asm20 -N 1000 --secondary=no",
                   fn_query       = fn_hap2_dedup,
                   fn_out         = fn_hap2_hap1_paf,
                   thread         = params$thread,
                   exe_minimap2   = params$exe_minimap)
}

# swap the positions of hap1 and hap2
if (!file.exists(fn_union_paf) || params$redo) {
    ls_fields <- strsplit(readLines(fn_hap2_hap1_paf), "\t", fixed = TRUE)
    ls_fields <- vapply(ls_fields, function(f) {
                    f[c(1:4, 6:9)] <- f[c(6:9, 1:4)]
                    paste(f, collapse = "\t")
                 }, character(1))

    # combine with the previous run
    writeLines(c(readLines(fn_hap1_hap2_paf), ls_fields), con=fn_union_paf)
    rm(ls_fields)
}

# calculate the coverage of each pair
df_paf <- f_read_paf(fn_union_paf)

# filter alignments
df_pairs <- df_paf %>%
                filter(alen >= 10000) %>%
                mutate(identity = ifelse(is.na(de), nmatch / alen, 1 - de)) %>%
                filter(identity >= 0.9) %>%
                group_by(h1 = qname, h2 = tname) %>%
                summarise(
                    h1_len     = first(qlen),
                    h2_len     = first(tlen),
                    n_aln      = n(),
                    aligned_bp = sum(alen),
                    identity   = sum(identity * alen) / sum(alen),
                    h1_cov     = f_calculate_merged_len(qstart, qend) / h1_len,
                    h2_cov     = f_calculate_merged_len(tstart, tend) / h2_len
                )

# extract the best partner of each contig
df_pairs <- df_pairs %>%
                group_by(h1) %>% mutate(best_for_h1 = h2 == h2[which.max(h1_cov)]) %>%
                group_by(h2) %>% mutate(best_for_h2 = h1 == h1[which.max(h2_cov)]) %>%
                ungroup() %>%
                mutate(reciprocal = best_for_h1 & best_for_h2)

# save the data.frame                
df_out <- df_pairs %>%
    arrange(desc(aligned_bp)) %>%
    filter(h1_cov >= 0.01 | h2_cov >= 0.01) %>%
    transmute(h1,
              h1_len,
              h2,
              h2_len,
              n_aln,
              aligned_bp,
              identity    = sprintf("%.4f", identity),
              h1_cov      = sprintf("%.3f", h1_cov),
              h2_cov      = sprintf("%.3f", h2_cov),
              best_for_h1 = best_for_h1,
              best_for_h2 = best_for_h2,
              reciprocal  = reciprocal)

data.table::fwrite(df_out, file = fn_pairs, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
```

```{r meryl}
# set k-mer size
k_meryl <- 31

# store the fastq files as list
ls_parent_reads <- list(decipiens = c(params$fn_ref_decipiens_r1, params$fn_ref_decipiens_r2),
                        virginea  = c(params$fn_ref_virginea_r1,  params$fn_ref_virginea_r2))

# change working directory
setwd(outdir_assignment_dvkmers)

# iterate over parental lineages
for (parent in names(ls_parent_reads)) {
    # output databases
    fn_db       <- paste0("E_", parent, ".meryl")
    fn_filtered <- paste0("E_", parent, ".filtered.meryl")

    # count k-mers
    if (!dir.exists(fn_db)) {
        f_meryl_count(ls_fn_reads = ls_parent_reads[[parent]],
                      fn_db       = fn_db,
                      k           = k_meryl,
                      thread      = params$thread,
                      exe_meryl   = params$exe_meryl)
    }

    # filter k-mers
    if (!dir.exists(fn_filtered)) {
        f_meryl_filter(fn_db         = fn_db,
                       fn_out        = fn_filtered,
                       filter_params = "greater-than 5",
                       thread        = params$thread,
                       exe_meryl     = params$exe_meryl) 
    }
}

# extract unique k-mers
fn_dec_filtered <- "E_decipiens.filtered.meryl"
fn_vir_filtered <- "E_virginea.filtered.meryl"

if (!dir.exists("E_decipiens.unique.meryl") || params$redo) {
    f_meryl_operator(operator  = "difference",
                     fn_db1    = fn_dec_filtered,
                     fn_db2    = fn_vir_filtered,
                     fn_out    = "E_decipiens.unique.meryl",
                     thread    = params$thread,
                     exe_meryl = params$exe_meryl)
}

if (!dir.exists("E_virginea.unique.meryl") || params$redo) {
    f_meryl_operator(operator  = "difference",
                     fn_db1    = fn_vir_filtered,
                     fn_db2    = fn_dec_filtered,
                     fn_out    = "E_virginea.unique.meryl",
                     thread    = params$thread,
                     exe_meryl = params$exe_meryl)
}

if (!dir.exists("ref_union.unique.meryl") || params$redo) {
    f_meryl_operator(operator  = "symmetric-difference",
                     fn_db1    = fn_dec_filtered,
                     fn_db2    = fn_vir_filtered,
                     fn_out    = "ref_union.unique.meryl",
                     thread    = params$thread,
                     exe_meryl = params$exe_meryl)
}

# count k-mers for E. x phylacis
if (!dir.exists("E_phylacis.meryl")) {
    f_meryl_count(ls_fn_reads = fn_filtered_fastqgz,
                  fn_db       = "E_phylacis.meryl",
                  k           = k_meryl,
                  thread      = params$thread,
                  exe_meryl   = params$exe_meryl)
}

# filter k-mers
if (!dir.exists("E_phylacis.filtered.meryl")) {
    f_meryl_filter(fn_db         = "E_phylacis.meryl",
                   fn_out        = "E_phylacis.filtered.meryl",
                   filter_params = "greater-than 9",
                   thread        = params$thread,
                   exe_meryl     = params$exe_meryl) 
}

# create a new directory
dir.create(file.path(outdir_assignment_dvkmers, "merqury_out"), recursive=T)
setwd(file.path(outdir_assignment_dvkmers, "merqury_out"))

# run merqury.sh
fn_hapmers_count <- file.path(outdir_assignment_dvkmers, "merqury_out", "E_phylacis_trio.hapmers.count")

if (!file.exists(fn_hapmers_count) || params$redo) {
    f_merqury_trio(db_reads    = file.path(outdir_assignment_dvkmers, "E_phylacis.filtered.meryl"),
                   db_ref1     = file.path(outdir_assignment_dvkmers, "E_virginea.unique.meryl"),
                   db_ref2     = file.path(outdir_assignment_dvkmers, "E_decipiens.unique.meryl"),
                   hap1        = fn_hap1_dedup,
                   hap2        = fn_hap2_dedup,
                   prefix      = "E_phylacis_trio",
                   exe_merqury = params$exe_merqury) 
}

# change working directory
setwd(currentdir)
```

```{r final}
# output files
fn_ctg_parent <- file.path(outdir_assignment_final, "parent_of_contig.tsv")

# set the opposite parent
ls_opposite <- c(virginea="decipiens", decipiens="virginea")

# extract the length of each contig
ls_length <- c()
for (hap in c(fn_hap1_dedup, fn_hap2_dedup)) {
    df_fai <- data.table::fread(paste0(hap, ".fai"), sep="\t", header=FALSE, select=1:2, col.names=c("contig", "length"))
    ls_length <- c(ls_length, setNames(df_fai$length, df_fai$contig))
}

# extract the best partner of every contig from the pairs table (both directions)
df_pairs <- data.table::fread(fn_pairs, sep = "\t", colClasses = list(character = c("h1", "h2")))
df_best  <- bind_rows(df_pairs %>% transmute(contig = h1, partner = h2, cov = h1_cov, identity),
                      df_pairs %>% transmute(contig = h2, partner = h1, cov = h2_cov, identity)) %>%
                group_by(contig) %>%
                slice_max(cov, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
                ungroup()

# intrinsic evidence: delta ID call
df_dvscore <- data.table::fread(file.path(outdir_assignment_dvscoring, "dv_scoring.tsv"), sep = "\t", colClasses = list(character = c("contig", "partner")))
ls_dv_call <- df_dvscore %>%
                filter(call %in% names(ls_opposite)) %>%
                select(contig, call) %>%
                deframe()

# intrinsic evidence: hapmer majority
df_hapmers <- data.table::fread(fn_hapmers_count, sep = "\t")
ls_hap_call <- df_hapmers %>%
                    transmute(contig  = Contig,
                              n_vir   = as.numeric(.data[["E_virginea.unique"]]),
                              n_dec   = as.numeric(.data[["E_decipiens.unique"]]),
                              n_total = n_vir + n_dec,
                              call    = case_when(n_total >= 1000 & n_vir / n_total >= 0.9 ~ "virginea",
                                                  n_total >= 1000 & n_dec / n_total >= 0.9 ~ "decipiens")) %>%
                    filter(!is.na(call)) %>%
                    select(contig, call) %>%
                    deframe()

# store everything together in a data.frame
df_contig <- tibble(contig = names(ls_length), length = as.numeric(ls_length)) %>%
                mutate(hap = if_else(startsWith(contig, "h1"), "hap1", "hap2")) %>%
                arrange(hap, desc(length))

# add best partner, coverage and identity
df_contig <- df_contig %>%
                left_join(df_best %>% rename(partner_cov = cov, partner_identity = identity), by = "contig") %>%
                mutate(partner          = coalesce(partner, "-"),
                       partner_cov      = coalesce(partner_cov, 0),
                       partner_identity = coalesce(partner_identity, 0))

# add intrinsic evidences
df_contig <- df_contig %>%
                mutate(dv_call     = unname(ls_dv_call[contig]),
                       hapmer_call = unname(ls_hap_call[contig]),
                       intrinsic   = case_when(is.na(dv_call)                              ~ hapmer_call,
                                               is.na(hapmer_call) | hapmer_call == dv_call ~ dv_call,
                                               .default = NA_character_))

# add the parental chromosomes
df_contig <- df_contig %>%
                left_join(df_dvscore %>% select(contig, dec_chrom, vir_chrom), by = "contig")

# set the parent of each chromosome-scale contig
df_chr_parent <- df_contig %>%
                     filter(contig %in% ls_anchors, !is.na(intrinsic)) %>%
                     select(contig, parent = intrinsic)

# save the table
ls_parent_chrom <- deframe(df_chr_parent)
data.table::fwrite(df_chr_parent, file=file.path(outdir_assignment_final, "parent_of_chromosome.tsv"), sep="\t", quote=F, col.names=FALSE)

# log chromosome-scale contigs without a parent
ls_no_parent <- setdiff(ls_anchors, names(ls_parent_chrom))
if (length(ls_no_parent) > 0) {
    log4r::warn(fn_logger, paste0("Chromosome-scale contigs without a parent: ", paste(ls_no_parent, collapse=", ")))
}

# apply the rules in priority order
df_contig <- df_contig %>%
                mutate(partner_parent = unname(ls_parent_chrom[partner]),
                       rule   = case_when(contig %in% names(ls_parent_chrom)           ~ "chromosome",
                                          !is.na(partner_parent) & partner_cov >= 0.5  ~ "group",
                                          !is.na(intrinsic)                            ~ "intrinsic",
                                          .default = "unassigned"),
                       parent = case_when(rule == "chromosome" ~ unname(ls_parent_chrom[contig]),
                                          rule == "group"      ~ unname(ls_opposite[partner_parent]),
                                          rule == "intrinsic"  ~ intrinsic,
                                          .default = "unassigned")) %>%
                select(-partner_parent)

# add the evidences
df_contig <- f_check_all(df_contig   = df_contig,
                         ls_opposite = ls_opposite,
                         min_cov     = 0.5)

# save the data.frame
df_out <- data.table::data.table(contig           = df_contig$contig,
                                 hap              = df_contig$hap,
                                 length           = df_contig$length,
                                 rule             = df_contig$rule,
                                 parent           = df_contig$parent,
                                 partner          = df_contig$partner,
                                 partner_cov      = sprintf("%.2f", df_contig$partner_cov),
                                 partner_identity = sprintf("%.3f", df_contig$partner_identity),
                                 dv_call          = ifelse(is.na(df_contig$dv_call), "-", df_contig$dv_call),
                                 hapmer_call      = ifelse(is.na(df_contig$hapmer_call), "-", df_contig$hapmer_call),
                                 check            = df_contig$check,
                                 check_intrinsic  = df_contig$check_intrinsic,
                                 check_pair       = df_contig$check_pair,
                                 check_synteny    = df_contig$check_synteny)

data.table::fwrite(df_out, file=fn_ctg_parent, sep="\t", quote=FALSE)

# save the interleaved format
df_evidence <- f_evidence_table(df_contig  = df_contig,
                                df_dvscore = df_dvscore,
                                df_hapmers = df_hapmers)
for (hap in c("hap1", "hap2")) {
    data.table::fwrite(f_interleave_partners(df_evidence, hap),
                       file.path(outdir_assignment_final, paste0("evidence_", hap, ".tsv")),
                       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, bom = TRUE, scipen = 50, na = "-")
}

# save a list of contigs per parent
for (parent in c("virginea", "decipiens", "unassigned")) {
  writeLines(df_contig$contig[df_contig$parent == parent], con=file.path(outdir_assignment_final, paste0(parent, "_contig.txt")))
}
```
